title: Insider Trading Policy

tiers.name: Restricted Persons
tiers.description: All Directors of Spark New Zealand, the Managing Director, all members of the Leadership Team and their direct reports, principal business unit/division/function managers, CEO's Office and Group Finance staff, IT staff with access to a Leadership Team member's email or documents, and other persons designated by the Company Secretary. Subject to black-out periods, an express unvested-hedging ban, and a notify-and-consent regime for all dealing.

tiers.name: Directors
tiers.description: Directors of Spark New Zealand Limited or Spark Finance Limited, and the Managing Director/direct reports; a subset of Restricted Persons whose dealing must additionally be approved by the Chairman of the Board (not merely the Company Secretary) and who have separate disclosure obligations under a companion document.

tiers.name: Associates
tiers.description: Spouse, children, other relatives, associates, trusts of which the person is a trustee, and companies the person controls; employees and directors are treated as responsible for dealing by trusts and companies they control.

definitions.hedging_definition: any transaction (including any hedging or derivative transaction) which will limit that person's economic risk in relation to such unvested shares, options or rights

windows.end_anchor: first trading day after the release of half-year results to the Stock Exchanges
first trading day after the release of full-year results to the Stock Exchanges

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: Company Secretary may determine 'such other period' as a black-out period, notified to Restricted Persons; not stated to be confidential.

rules.detail: No express derivatives rule for general employees. Restricted Securities include options and derivatives and any financial product created over or in respect of Spark New Zealand securities, and 'deal' includes acquiring, disposing or agreeing to do so, so an OTC put/call is a deal, but general employees face no consent regime and may deal freely except while in possession of Inside Information.
rules.evidence: any other securities of Spark New Zealand or its subsidiaries, and any options, derivatives or other financial products issued or created over or in respect of any securities of Spark New Zealand or its subsidiaries.

rules.detail: Derivatives fall within Restricted Securities; Restricted Persons must notify the Company Secretary and obtain consent (via the Dealing by Insiders Form) before any dealing, outside black-out periods and only while not in possession of Inside Information.
rules.evidence: Before dealing in Spark New Zealand Restricted Securities (or having Spark New Zealand Restricted Securities dealt in your name or on your behalf), at any time, Restricted Persons must: notify the Company Secretary of their intention to deal in Spark New Zealand Restricted Securities and seek consent to do so

rules.detail: Absolute ban on hedging or any transaction limiting economic risk of 'at-risk' remuneration, i.e. unvested shares, options or rights where performance hurdles or other conditions are not yet met.
rules.evidence: A Restricted Person shall not enter into any transaction (including any hedging or derivative transaction) which will limit that person's economic risk in relation to such unvested shares, options or rights.

rules.section: Hedging and other Dealings; Additional Rules - Consent
rules.detail: The express hedging ban is limited to 'at-risk' (unvested) remuneration. Hedging vested, unrestricted shares is not named and is caught only as a dealing requiring notification and consent outside black-out periods.
rules.evidence: Restricted Persons are prohibited from entering into hedging arrangements to limit their exposure in relation to 'at-risk' remuneration (meaning unvested shares, options or rights issued or acquired under the Spark New Zealand employee incentive schemes where performance hurdles have not yet been achieved or other conditions have not yet been met).

rules.detail: The hedging ban and its exception are stated only for Restricted Persons; general employees have no express or consent-based hedging regime beyond the fundamental no-dealing-with-Inside-Information rule.
Monetisation (e.g. a prepaid forward) is not named. It is an agreement to deal or a financial product created over Restricted Securities, so it requires notification and consent before dealing.
rules.evidence: 'deal' includes applying for, acquiring or disposing of Spark New Zealand Restricted Securities or agreeing to do so, whether as principal or agent.

rules.detail: Not addressed for general employees outside the Restricted Persons consent regime beyond the Inside Information prohibition.

rules.section: Guidance - Short selling should be avoided
rules.detail: Instruction not to short sell, expressly extended to using derivatives to short sell; applies to all directors, officers and employees, not only Restricted Persons.
rules.evidence: to reduce the risk of an allegation of insider trading, do not short sell Spark New Zealand Restricted Securities, including the use of derivatives to short sell Spark New Zealand Restricted Securities.

rules.detail: Securities lending is not named anywhere and is not listed in the deal definition; only borrowing by third-party short sellers is described, not lending by insiders.

CFDs are not named. As a financial product created over or in respect of securities they fall within Restricted Securities, but general employees face no consent regime, only the fundamental Inside Information ban.
rules.evidence: any options, derivatives or other financial products issued or created over or in respect of any securities of Spark New Zealand or its subsidiaries.

rules.detail: Not named; caught as a dealing in a financial product over Restricted Securities requiring notification and consent.
rules.evidence: Before dealing in Spark New Zealand Restricted Securities ... Restricted Persons must: notify the Company Secretary of their intention to deal ... and seek consent

rules.section: Margin lending and other secured financial arrangements
rules.detail: Outright ban on margin lending in respect of Restricted Securities, applying to employees generally, with no carve-out or consent route mentioned.
rules.evidence: Employees are prohibited from entering into margin lending and other secured financing arrangements in respect of Spark New Zealand Restricted Securities.

rules.section: Margin lending and other secured financial arrangements
rules.detail: A charge, lien or pledge over Restricted Securities is not named by that term, but is swept in as an 'other secured financing arrangement', which is expressly banned.
rules.evidence: Employees are prohibited from entering into margin lending and other secured financing arrangements in respect of Spark New Zealand Restricted Securities.

rules.section: Margin lending and other secured financial arrangements
rules.detail: Blanket ban on margin lending and any other secured financing arrangement in respect of Restricted Securities, for employees generally; no tier or security-state carve-out and no exemption authority stated.
rules.evidence: Employees are prohibited from entering into margin lending and other secured financing arrangements in respect of Spark New Zealand Restricted Securities.

rules.section: Guidance - Short term dealing should be avoided
rules.detail: Buying and selling within a three-month period should not be undertaken unless exceptional circumstances are discussed and approved by the Company Secretary.
rules.evidence: You should not engage in short term dealing unless there are exceptional circumstances discussed and approved by the Company Secretary.

clearance.section: Additional Rules - Consent; Notification of Dealing
clearance.evidence: A consent is only valid for a period of 10 trading days after notification. ... A consent is automatically deemed to be withdrawn if the person becomes aware of Inside Information prior to dealing. ... Once dealing is complete this must be disclosed to Spark New Zealand's Company Secretary.

clearance.approver: Chairman of the Spark New Zealand Board (Dealing by Insiders Form submitted to the Company Secretary)
clearance.evidence: All dealing involving: 1. Spark New Zealand Directors; or 2. Greater than 100,000 shares/options, must be approved by the Chairman of the Spark New Zealand Board. The completed Dealing by Insiders Form should be submitted to the Spark New Zealand Company Secretary.

short_term.basis: buying and selling over a very short time period
carve_outs: exceptional circumstances discussed and approved by the Company Secretary
short_term.evidence: Short term dealing is buying and selling Spark New Zealand Restricted Securities over a very short time period (within a three month period).

exceptions.evidence: Exceptional Circumstances may include: (i) where the Restricted Person is in severe financial hardship
where the Restricted Person is required by a court order or other court enforceable undertaking to transfer or sell Spark New Zealand Restricted Securities.

Nothing in this Policy precludes a Restricted Person or employee in possession of Inside Information from: receiving rights (zepos) under the Spark New Zealand Share Rights Scheme ... acquiring Spark New Zealand shares through the exercise of rights ... acquiring Spark New Zealand shares through the vesting of restricted shares
dispose of Spark New Zealand shares through the acceptance of a takeover offer under the Takeovers Code
acquire Spark New Zealand shares through a pro rata rights issue
dispose of Spark New Zealand shares through a pro rata share buyback or cancellation of shares by a scheme of arrangement.

external_documents: Additional Disclosure Requirements for Directors and Officers
Spark New Zealand Market Disclosure Policy
exemption_authority: Company Secretary may grant a specific exemption to deal within a black-out period only in Exceptional Circumstances (severe financial hardship or a court order/enforceable undertaking). More generally, permission to deal (Company Secretary, or Chairman for Directors/dealings over 100,000 shares) 'can be given or refused ... in its discretion, without giving reasons' and can be withdrawn if circumstances change; there is no exemption authority for the margin lending/secured financing ban.
jurisdiction_overlays: United States insider trading law (American Depositary Shares)
Luxembourg Stock Exchange (Spark Finance Limited debt securities)

bespoke_clauses.clause: Employees are prohibited from entering into margin lending and other secured financing arrangements in respect of Spark New Zealand Restricted Securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The loan leg of a funded collar, secured on the collared shares, is expressly and unconditionally prohibited for all employees regardless of vesting state or tier, with no clearance or exemption route identified anywhere in the policy.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Any permission to deal can be given or refused by Spark New Zealand in its discretion, without giving reasons. ... Permission to deal can be withdrawn if new information comes to light or there is a change in circumstances.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even the unfunded derivative legs of a collar are subject to unreasoned, revocable consent, so a cleared trade cannot be relied upon as final until executed within the 10 trading day validity window.

bespoke_clauses.clause: There are no 'safe' periods for dealing in Spark New Zealand Restricted Securities. You may never deal in Spark New Zealand Restricted Securities if you have Inside Information.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Collar entry, unwind, roll or settlement must always be individually checked against Inside Information status; there is no blanket open window that removes that check.

bespoke_clauses.clause: A consent is automatically deemed to be withdrawn if the person becomes aware of Inside Information prior to dealing.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A cleared collar must be priced and executed within the 10 trading day validity and becomes unexecutable if Inside Information arises before signing.

bespoke_clauses.clause: All dealing involving: 1. Spark New Zealand Directors; or 2. Greater than 100,000 shares/options, must be approved by the Chairman of the Spark New Zealand Board.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A collar of institutional size (or entered by a director) escalates approval to the Chairman rather than the Company Secretary alone, adding a decision-maker to the bank's execution timetable.

bespoke_clauses.clause: You cannot avoid the insider trading laws by dealing in Spark New Zealand Restricted Securities through companies or trusts you control.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Routing the collar or loan through a family trust or controlled company does not escape the consent regime or the secured financing ban.

summary: A funded collar is not possible under this policy, although the unfunded hedge legs could be. Restricted Persons (directors, the Managing Director, Leadership Team and other designated staff) may enter a purchased put and written call over vested, unrestricted shares as a dealing requiring prior notification and consent from the Company Secretary (Chairman of the Board if the person is a Director or the size exceeds 100,000 shares/options), executed within 10 trading days, outside the half-year and full-year black-out periods, and only while not in possession of Inside Information; the express hedging ban applies only to unvested 'at-risk' remuneration. However, the policy separately and unconditionally prohibits employees from 'entering into margin lending and other secured financing arrangements' in respect of Spark New Zealand Restricted Securities, with no tier carve-out, security-state distinction or exemption authority, so the loan leg secured on the collared shares cannot be put in place. Consent for the derivative legs is discretionary, may be refused without reasons, and lapses automatically if Inside Information arises before execution. General employees outside the Restricted Persons/Directors tiers face no consent regime at all beyond the fundamental Inside Information prohibition, but are equally bound by the secured financing ban.
